prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1459; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the impact, and the presentation is typical for this type of cervical strain. Over the course of 17 visits, care included manual therapy, a home stretching program, and graded activity. Treatment duration was somewhat longer than is typical for an injury of this kind, and progress was gradual. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the neck. No prior injury or treatment to the same body region is known from the patient's history or available records. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no repeated or duplicate entries. Patient is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home exercise. Future care needs will be reassessed at the next scheduled review.
